ctor.issue: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses, statuses or quests.

CanonicalVars.maps_to: nothing -- the sim passes the literal 1 (shame.py:128)
CanonicalVars.issue: `new DynamicVar("Frail", 1m)` (Shame.cs:22) is a printed var with no `_frail` in `_init_vars`, so `magic_number` returns None where the game prints 1. Same shape as card/doubt's PowerVar<WeakPower>(1). Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed number the sim's `magic_number` cannot surface, so `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:455-489) encodes the card without it. DORMANT for game fidelity, LIVE for the observation encoder.

OnTurnEndInHand.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<FrailPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["Frail"].BaseValue, null, this)` (Shame.cs:34) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, FrailPower, 1)`. The NULL applier is reproduced (the sim leaves `applier` at its None default). The explicit `if (powerModel != null && !alreadyHasFrail) powerModel.SkipNextDurationTick = true` (35-38) needs no counterpart: `PowerCmd.Apply` already sets that flag unconditionally for player-side debuffs on the NEW-power path (PowerCmd.cs:144-147), so Shame's line is redundant with the engine in the fresh case and correctly absent in the already-Frail case. Structurally identical to card/doubt's OnTurnEndInHand, and it carries the same BLAST RADIUS note (rule 3): the sim's `skip_next_tick` write sits after the new-vs-stacking if/else (cmds.py:331-332) so it also fires on RE-STACKING, which is power_cmd step 20.

OnPlay.rationale: Shame.cs declares no OnPlay and the card is Unplayable.
